# Thumos

> Sovereign Rust mobile OS for the AGM M7.

Thumos replaces Android/Linux on the AGM M7 with a Rust kernel and userspace for counter-surveillance, secure communication, identity protection, and operator-controlled mobile computing.

## Binary

`crates/thumos` - bare-metal ARM kernel built for `armv7a-none-eabi`.

Workspace userspace crates cover input, radios, telephony, security, crypto, radio tools, and UI.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): kernel/userspace layers and crate roles
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): phase, blockers, and open threads
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted OS architecture decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): thumos vocabulary
